note: Read by tools/factory/fleet-scorecard.py (--fleet, and project mode when present) to set each row's health {status, reasons}. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (metrics/README.md law 1): RED names an OVERDUE duty for the weekly hub review; it never gates a commit, a landing or a lane, and no value changes the tool's exit code. RED when: bus_publish days_since > bus_publish_days (or never published); fold_lag oldest unfolded doctrine commit > fold_oldest_unfolded_hours; kernel_filing days_since > kernel_filing_days (or never filed); tool_census over the baseline schedule max in force AND the project holds a copy or double registration; rule_coverage percent below the project's OWN declared floor. A null measure is UNMEASURED, never GREEN. Changing a threshold is a lead decision recorded in the commit that changes it. projects.<name> entries are scorecard config sections (fleet/scorecard-config/v1) applied under --fleet; a project's own factory-pins/fleet-scorecard.config.json overrides them.
